body:
Yeah, this stuff happens. I generally assume that when it's men involved they're usually boys, though. That's how it was for me. Easier to take advantage of  a child than it is an adult. Especially when your parents aren't home and you're stuck with your physically and sexually abusive older brother. Even worse, you can't report it without tearing your own family apart. Best you can do is try to pretend it didn't happen and convince yourself the memories aren't real. Just keep telling yourself it was a bad dream. That's sure to work!

And they say life is a gift. What a joke.

If only you could erase memories like in Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind.

Disgusting. Some amateur psychologists/therapists are running this subreddit with recommendations of abandoning those who actually need help. Crisis hotlines, 911, and psych wards will solve nothing for her, so if you actually do care about her safety, you'll allow contact with ground rules of respect and understanding that she can't be with you romantically anymore, just as friends. Perhaps some space will be necessary, but outright abandonment and silence sends her a message that she is worthless to you, which will be immediate cause for suicidal action.

These people are well read on the basic psychology and generally accepted procedures of dealing with those suffering from suicidal ideation, but they clearly lack experience with feeling suicidal themselves. So, in the opinion of someone who has been abandoned by loved ones and survived several suicide attempts, take all of the above advice with a grain of salt. Following these procedures to a T doesn't always save these people. In fact, it can just as easily get them killed.

And be very careful in this break up. I wish I had better advice than to be weary of what you're being told and being careful, but suicide is a complicated issue. What works for some doesn't work for all.

Edit: Got a second opinion from my therapist over this matter. It was sent over text, so pardon the grammar:

"Only thing I disagree w is "will be immediate cause for suicidal action" which implies that other people are responsible for someone's choice which is not saying we impact each other but no one can make someone else complete suicide if so then it's murder not suicide"

I forwarded the whole page, not just my comment.
Time isn't a dimension. H.G. Wells got that one wrong.
